svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cleat: a 60 mm length of 40 x 40 x 4 angle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upright face: one 11 mm hole at mid-length, 24 mm up from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: underside of the flat face (the leg's pin).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flat face: two 9 mm holes, 18 mm each side of the middle,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pad: a 100 x 100 mm square of 6 mm plate; two 9 mm holes to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: match the cleat, countersunk from below.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: M8 countersunk screws up through the pad, nyloc nuts on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cleat. The leg's flat face lies on the cleat's upright face,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside it; one M10 bolt, nyloc nut, snug (the leg can pivot).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the pad sits flat with the screw heads flush.
